about.text: Pearl O. Madrial has noted an appeal from the district court’s order granting Defendant’s Fed. R. Civ. P. 12(b)(1) motion and dismissing for lack of subject matter jurisdiction her civil action alleging that Defendant illegally appointed a special counsel who illegally brought criminal charges against then-candidate for President Donald Trump and that she likely would involuntarily withhold her vote for the candidate of her choice.
